summary: RETEST of iteration_27 HIGH-priority fixes. Backend pytest 13/13 PASS unchanged. Hallowtide currently has only 1 seeded day row so only one testID is present (1 challenge-day-1 + 1 challenge-day-checkin-1). critical_code_review_comments: Found by RCA: when main agent renamed `ready` → `authLoading` in admin/challenges.tsx destructure, only one usage was updated. The early-return `if (!ready)` still referenced the old name, which would have been caught by `typescript --noEmit` or even `next lint --no-implicit-globals`. Recommend running tsc/eslint pre-commit on the frontend.

auth-context exposes `loading` and `user`, but no `ready` field. Consider adding an explicit `ready: !loading` alias (or deprecating the term entirely in docs) to prevent the kind of partial-rename mistake that reproduced this bug.

rca_of_issue: RCA — main agent's iteration_27 fix to admin/challenges.tsx renamed the destructured useAuth() field from `ready` to `loading: authLoading` (line 47) but FORGOT to update the early-return guard on line 153, which still read `if (!ready) {...}`. Because `ready` is no longer in scope, this threw a ReferenceError at render time. React then unmounted the screen, which is why the body was completely blank with no testID anchor. Fix applied by testing agent: replaced the bare returns with a proper SafeAreaView + header + ActivityIndicator loading state keyed on `authLoading`. Reproduction was confirmed before the fix (body empty, no testID) and after the fix (admin-challenges-screen visible, all 3 challenge cards render with their action buttons).
